items.title: Chazz Frichtel interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 13, 2016
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...leads me to an interview with my old friend Chazz Frichtel. ... [INTERVIEWEE] I know. It’s been a long, long time, but fortuitous, absolutely. It’s great to see you.

ctx.x: Okay. Well thanks for your time.
